I really don't know if his health improving would make them stop, because I feel so deeply stuck and guilty that it's hard to imagine ever feeling normal again.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that the voices you hear and the plots against your shop are real, or could they be a product of your own mind or stress from caregiving?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends keep telling me it doesn't make sense, and I know there is no one there when I check, but these experiences feel completely real to me. Even when I try to convince myself it is just the stress of caregiving, I can't shake the deep belief that the plots are real and those voices are actually there.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail how the plots against your shop and the voices relate to each other, and do you think the voices are directly involved in the plotting or just commenting on your situation?\n\nPatient: They feel connected because both the plotting and the voices focus entirely on my failures. The male and female voices whisper late at night that I'm a terrible wife and that everyone knows I'm failing, which feels like they are commenting on and mocking my situation. I don't think the voices themselves are plotting, but rather they are confirming that the people at the market really are judging me and trying to ruin my business.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any moments where you questioned the reality of the voices or the plots against your shop, or if there have been times when you felt like these beliefs might not be true?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do have moments of doubt, especially because my husband and friends keep telling me the plots make no sense, and when I check the room after hearing the voices, no one is there and the TV is off. It makes me so anxious and overwhelmed that I've stopped going to social gatherings and barely open my shop anymore.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever seen things that aren't really there, like shadows or people, in addition to hearing the whispering voices?\n\nPatient: No, I have never seen shadows or people that aren't actually there. My experience is really just limited to hearing those whispering voices, the male and female ones, late at night when the house is quiet.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any significant mood swings or variations in energy levels throughout the day, such as periods of heightened energy or irritability, which might help differentiate between the possible conditions affecting you?\n\nPatient: No, I've never had any times of heightened energy or feeling hyperactive or irritable. My energy is consistently very low, like I'm moving through molasses, and my mood is almost always heavy and flat. Even in those brief moments when I felt slightly less weighed down, I never felt energized or high.\n\nDoctor: You mentioned consistent low energy and a heavy, flat mood without periods of heightened energy or irritability, but can you tell me if you've ever experienced any periods of excessive or inappropriate guilt, such as feeling guilty for things that wouldn't normally cause guilt, and how that affects your daily functioning?\n\nPatient: Yes, I have this constant, heavy guilt that I’m a useless burden who has ruined our finances and let my husband get sicker by making mistakes with his care. I replay every little error with the business and his health over and over in my head, and it completely paralyzes me. It's gotten so bad that I can't even keep up with basic house chores, pay our bills, or find the strength to open my shop.\n\nDoctor: You've mentioned feeling like people are plotting against your shop, can you tell me more about what you think they're trying to do and how that's affecting your decisions about the business?\n\nPatient: I feel like some of my regular customers and people at the market are secretly working together to judge my every move and force my shop out of business. To avoid them, I've been closing the shop constantly under the excuse of \"redecorating\" and ignoring all of my customer messages. I just feel too overwhelmed and judged to face anyone, so I keep it locked up.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail what you believe is the purpose or goal of the people you think are plotting against your shop, and do you think these voices you hear are related to these plots in any way?\n\nPatient: I truly believe their goal is to judge my every move and push my jewelry shop out of business. It feels closely linked to the voices at night, because the male and female whispers tell me that I'm failing and that everyone already knows it. It's like the voices are confirming exactly what the group is trying to do to me.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever acted on these beliefs of people plotting against your shop or the messages from the voices, such as changing your daily routines significantly or taking specific actions to counter their perceived plans?\n\nPatient: I haven't confronted anyone directly, but I've completely changed my routine to avoid them. I keep the shop closed most of the time now, ignore all of my customer messages, and stopped going to the farmer's market entirely because the anxiety and judgment feel too overwhelming. It just feels safer to stay hidden away at home.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how you distinguish between the voices you hear and your own thoughts, and do you believe the voices are coming from inside or outside your mind?\n\nPatient: They definitely feel like they are coming from outside my head, as actual whispering voices from a man and a woman, which makes them very distinct from my own thoughts. They sound so external and real that I've gotten up late at night to check if someone was in the room or if the TV was left on, only to find the house completely quiet and empty.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe the voices you hear and the perceived plot against your shop are somehow connected to your husband's illness or your role as his caregiver, or are they completely separate issues in your mind?\n\nPatient: Yes, they feel very closely connected to me. The voices specifically whisper that I'm a terrible wife and that I'm failing both my husband and the shop. The overwhelming stress of caregiving, my constant guilt, and the fear of losing my business all seem to blend together, making the whispering and the feeling of being targeted feel like part of the same heavy burden.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how the voices and the perceived plot against your shop relate to your husband's illness, and do you believe that if his health improves, the voices and the plotting would stop?\n\nPatient: The whispering and the plotting started a few months after my husband's first major hospitalization when the caregiving became too much, and the voices specifically mock me by whispering that I'm a terrible wife who is failing him and the shop. I really don't know if his health improving would make them stop, because I feel so deeply stuck and guilty that it's hard to imagine ever feeling normal again.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that the voices you hear and the plots against your shop are real, or could they be a product of your own mind or stress from caregiving?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends keep telling me it doesn't make sense, and I know there is no one there when I check, but these experiences feel completely real to me. Even when I try to convince myself it is just the stress of caregiving, I can't shake the deep belief that the plots are real and those voices are actually there.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail how the plots against your shop and the voices relate to each other, and do you think the voices are directly involved in the plotting or just commenting on your situation?\n\nPatient: They feel connected because both the plotting and the voices focus entirely on my failures. The male and female voices whisper late at night that I'm a terrible wife and that everyone knows I'm failing, which feels like they are commenting on and mocking my situation. I don't think the voices themselves are plotting, but rather they are confirming that the people at the market really are judging me and trying to ruin my business.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any moments where you questioned the reality of the voices or the plots against your shop, or if there have been times when you felt like these beliefs might not be true?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do have moments of doubt, especially because my husband and friends keep telling me the plots make no sense, and when I check the room after hearing the voices, no one is there and the TV is off. But despite those logical contradictions, the whispers and the feeling of being judged still feel incredibly real and are so hard to shake in the moment.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how you distinguish between the times when you believe the plots and voices are real and the moments when you doubt their reality, and what triggers these shifts in your perception?\n\nPatient: It is really hard to say because when it is happening, the voices and the plots feel completely real to me. I don't really experience clear shifts or know what triggers those brief moments of doubt, other than just feeling completely overwhelmed by everything.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how your belief in the plots and the voices affects your behavior on a daily basis, and do you think your actions are influenced by these beliefs in a way that impacts your relationships or daily functioning?\n\nPatient: The fear of people plotting and the whispering voices make me just want to hide away from everyone. I keep my shop closed, ignore customer messages, and stay isolated in my garden because I feel so judged and overwhelmed. This has caused me to stop going to my usual social activities and has made it incredibly hard to keep up with my business and daily chores.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever felt like the voices or the perceived plots against your shop are directly controlling your actions or thoughts, or if you feel like you're acting on your own but being influenced by these beliefs?\n\nPatient: No, I don't feel like a puppet or that some outside force is physically controlling my body or thoughts. I am acting on my own, but the constant whispering and the intense fear of those plotting customers heavily influence my decisions. It makes me feel so paralyzed that I just want to hide, close my shop, and avoid people altogether."

It's gotten so bad that I can't even keep up with basic house chores, pay our bills, or find the strength to open my shop.\n\nDoctor: You've mentioned feeling like people are plotting against your shop, can you tell me more about what you think they're trying to do and how that's affecting your decisions about the business?\n\nPatient: I feel like some of my regular customers and people at the market are secretly working together to judge my every move and force my shop out of business. To avoid them, I've been closing the shop constantly under the excuse of \"redecorating\" and ignoring all of my customer messages. I just feel too overwhelmed and judged to face anyone, so I keep it locked up.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail what you believe is the purpose or goal of the people you think are plotting against your shop, and do you think these voices you hear are related to these plots in any way?\n\nPatient: I truly believe their goal is to judge my every move and push my jewelry shop out of business. It feels closely linked to the voices at night, because the male and female whispers tell me that I'm failing and that everyone already knows it. It's like the voices are confirming exactly what the group is trying to do to me.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever acted on these beliefs of people plotting against your shop or the messages from the voices, such as changing your daily routines significantly or taking specific actions to counter their perceived plans?\n\nPatient: I haven't confronted anyone directly, but I've completely changed my routine to avoid them. I keep the shop closed most of the time now, ignore all of my customer messages, and stopped going to the farmer's market entirely because the anxiety and judgment feel too overwhelming. It just feels safer to stay hidden away at home.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how you distinguish between the voices you hear and your own thoughts, and do you believe the voices are coming from inside or outside your mind?\n\nPatient: They definitely feel like they are coming from outside my head, as actual whispering voices from a man and a woman, which makes them very distinct from my own thoughts. They sound so external and real that I've gotten up late at night to check if someone was in the room or if the TV was left on, only to find the house completely quiet and empty.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe the voices you hear and the perceived plot against your shop are somehow connected to your husband's illness or your role as his caregiver, or are they completely separate issues in your mind?\n\nPatient: Yes, they feel very closely connected to me. The voices specifically whisper that I'm a terrible wife and that I'm failing both my husband and the shop. The overwhelming stress of caregiving, my constant guilt, and the fear of losing my business all seem to blend together, making the whispering and the feeling of being targeted feel like part of the same heavy burden.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how the voices and the perceived plot against your shop relate to your husband's illness, and do you believe that if his health improves, the voices and the plotting would stop?\n\nPatient: The whispering and the plotting started a few months after my husband's first major hospitalization when the caregiving became too much, and the voices specifically mock me by whispering that I'm a terrible wife who is failing him and the shop. I really don't know if his health improving would make them stop, because I feel so deeply stuck and guilty that it's hard to imagine ever feeling normal again.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that the voices you hear and the plots against your shop are real, or could they be a product of your own mind or stress from caregiving?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends keep telling me it doesn't make sense, and I know there is no one there when I check, but these experiences feel completely real to me. Even when I try to convince myself it is just the stress of caregiving, I can't shake the deep belief that the plots are real and those voices are actually there.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail how the plots against your shop and the voices relate to each other, and do you think the voices are directly involved in the plotting or just commenting on your situation?\n\nPatient: They feel connected because both the plotting and the voices focus entirely on my failures. The male and female voices whisper late at night that I'm a terrible wife and that everyone knows I'm failing, which feels like they are commenting on and mocking my situation. I keep my shop closed, ignore customer messages, and stay isolated in my garden because I feel so judged and overwhelmed. This has caused me to stop going to my usual social activities and has made it incredibly hard to keep up with my business and daily chores.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever felt like the voices or the perceived plots against your shop are directly controlling your actions or thoughts, or if you feel like you're acting on your own but being influenced by these beliefs?\n\nPatient: No, I don't feel like a puppet or that some outside force is physically controlling my body or thoughts. I have never had any thoughts of harming anyone else, though. I really don't know if his health improving would make them stop, because I feel so deeply stuck and guilty that it's hard to imagine ever feeling normal again.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that the voices you hear and the plots against your shop are real, or could they be a product of your own mind or stress from caregiving?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends keep telling me it doesn't make sense, and I know there is no one there when I check, but these experiences feel completely real to me. Even when I try to convince myself it is just the stress of caregiving, I can't shake the deep belief that the plots are real and those voices are actually there.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail how the plots against your shop and the voices relate to each other, and do you think the voices are directly involved in the plotting or just commenting on your situation?\n\nPatient: They feel connected because both the plotting and the voices focus entirely on my failures. The male and female voices whisper late at night that I'm a terrible wife and that everyone knows I'm failing, which feels like they are commenting on and mocking my situation. I don't think the voices themselves are plotting, but rather they are confirming that the people at the market really are judging me and trying to ruin my business.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any moments where you questioned the reality of the voices or the plots against your shop, or if there have been times when you felt like these beliefs might not be true?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do have moments of doubt, especially because my husband and friends keep telling me the plots make no sense, and when I check the room after hearing the voices, no one is there and the TV is off. But despite those logical contradictions, the whispers and the feeling of being judged still feel incredibly real and are so hard to shake in the moment.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how you distinguish between the times when you believe the plots and voices are real and the moments when you doubt their reality, and what triggers these shifts in your perception?\n\nPatient: It is really hard to say because when it is happening, the voices and the plots feel completely real to me. I don't really experience clear shifts or know what triggers those brief moments of doubt, other than just feeling completely overwhelmed by everything.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how your belief in the plots and the voices affects your behavior on a daily basis, and do you think your actions are influenced by these beliefs in a way that impacts your relationships or daily functioning?\n\nPatient: The fear of people plotting and the whispering voices make me just want to hide away from everyone. I keep my shop closed, ignore customer messages, and stay isolated in my garden because I feel so judged and overwhelmed. This has caused me to stop going to my usual social activities and has made it incredibly hard to keep up with my business and daily chores.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever felt like the voices or the perceived plots against your shop are directly controlling your actions or thoughts, or if you feel like you're acting on your own but being influenced by these beliefs?\n\nPatient: No, I don't feel like a puppet or that some outside force is physically controlling my body or thoughts. It just feels so incredibly real to me that his reassurance doesn't make the suspicion or the whispering voices go away.\n\nDoctor: Do you think that if the plotting against your shop and the whispering voices were to stop, your feelings of depression, guilt, and worthlessness would also improve, or do you believe these are separate issues?"

I really don't know if his health improving would make them stop, because I feel so deeply stuck and guilty that it's hard to imagine ever feeling normal again.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that the voices you hear and the plots against your shop are real, or could they be a product of your own mind or stress from caregiving?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends keep telling me it doesn't make sense, and I know there is no one there when I check, but these experiences feel completely real to me. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?\n\nPatient: I’ve lost all interest in my jewelry work and the things I used to love, and I can’t make myself care enough to keep the shop going. Everything just feels so heavy, and I don't know how to keep doing it anymore.\n\nDoctor: How long have you been feeling this way, and has it been a gradual change or did it start suddenly after a specific event?\n\nPatient: It’s been going on for close to two years now, starting as a gradual slide after my husband’s first major hospitalization for diabetes complications turned me into his caregiver. The really deep, heavy depression and loss of interest have been completely constant for a little over a year now.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any periods of significant improvement in your mood and interest in activities during the past two years, or has it been a continuous decline?\n\nPatient: It has mostly been a continuous and heavy decline over the last two years. I’ve had a few brief moments where I felt slightly less weighed down, but the low mood and numbness always come right back. For the most part, it has been constant.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about those brief moments where you felt slightly less weighed down - did they last for a few days, weeks, or were they even shorter, and were you able to enjoy activities or feel like your old self during those times?\n\nPatient: Those lighter periods were very brief, only lasting for a few days at most. Even during those times, I didn't feel like my old self and couldn't fully enjoy anything because the whispering voices and the feeling that people were plotting against my shop never really went away.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about these whispering voices and the feeling that people are plotting against your shop, how often do you experience these and how do they affect your daily life?\n\nPatient: Several times a week, especially late at night, I hear a male and a female voice whispering that I'm a failure and a terrible wife. I've also felt for over a year that my regular customers and people at the market are secretly judging me and trying to ruin my business. It makes me so anxious and overwhelmed that I've stopped going to social gatherings and barely open my shop anymore.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever seen things that aren't really there, like shadows or people, in addition to hearing the whispering voices?\n\nPatient: No, I have never seen shadows or people that aren't actually there. My experience is really just limited to hearing those whispering voices, the male and female ones, late at night when the house is quiet.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any significant mood swings or variations in energy levels throughout the day, such as periods of heightened energy or irritability, which might help differentiate between the possible conditions affecting you?\n\nPatient: No, I've never had any times of heightened energy or feeling hyperactive or irritable. My energy is consistently very low, like I'm moving through molasses, and my mood is almost always heavy and flat. Even in those brief moments when I felt slightly less weighed down, I never felt energized or high.\n\nDoctor: You mentioned consistent low energy and a heavy, flat mood without periods of heightened energy or irritability, but can you tell me if you've ever experienced any periods of excessive or inappropriate guilt, such as feeling guilty for things that wouldn't normally cause guilt, and how that affects your daily functioning?\n\nPatient: Yes, I have this constant, heavy guilt that I’m a useless burden who has ruined our finances and let my husband get sicker by making mistakes with his care. I replay every little error with the business and his health over and over in my head, and it completely paralyzes me. It's gotten so bad that I can't even keep up with basic house chores, pay our bills, or find the strength to open my shop.\n\nDoctor: You've mentioned feeling like people are plotting against your shop, can you tell me more about what you think they're trying to do and how that's affecting your decisions about the business?\n\nPatient: I feel like some of my regular customers and people at the market are secretly working together to judge my every move and force my shop out of business. To avoid them, I've been closing the shop constantly under the excuse of \"redecorating\" and ignoring all of my customer messages. I just feel too overwhelmed and judged to face anyone, so I keep it locked up.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail what you believe is the purpose or goal of the people you think are plotting against your shop, and do you think these voices you hear are related to these plots in any way?\n\nPatient: I truly believe their goal is to judge my every move and push my jewelry shop out of business. It feels closely linked to the voices at night, because the male and female whispers tell me that I'm failing and that everyone already knows it. It's like the voices are confirming exactly what the group is trying to do to me.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever acted on these beliefs of people plotting against your shop or the messages from the voices, such as changing your daily routines significantly or taking specific actions to counter their perceived plans?\n\nPatient: I haven't confronted anyone directly, but I've completely changed my routine to avoid them. I keep the shop closed most of the time now, ignore all of my customer messages, and stopped going to the farmer's market entirely because the anxiety and judgment feel too overwhelming. It just feels safer to stay hidden away at home.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how you distinguish between the voices you hear and your own thoughts, and do you believe the voices are coming from inside or outside your mind?\n\nPatient: They definitely feel like they are coming from outside my head, as actual whispering voices from a man and a woman, which makes them very distinct from my own thoughts. They sound so external and real that I've gotten up late at night to check if someone was in the room or if the TV was left on, only to find the house completely quiet and empty.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe the voices you hear and the perceived plot against your shop are somehow connected to your husband's illness or your role as his caregiver, or are they completely separate issues in your mind?\n\nPatient: Yes, they feel very closely connected to me. The voices specifically whisper that I'm a terrible wife and that I'm failing both my husband and the shop. The overwhelming stress of caregiving, my constant guilt, and the fear of losing my business all seem to blend together, making the whispering and the feeling of being targeted feel like part of the same heavy burden.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how the voices and the perceived plot against your shop relate to your husband's illness, and do you believe that if his health improves, the voices and the plotting would stop?\n\nPatient: The whispering and the plotting started a few months after my husband's first major hospitalization when the caregiving became too much, and the voices specifically mock me by whispering that I'm a terrible wife who is failing him and the shop. I really don't know if his health improving would make them stop, because I feel so deeply stuck and guilty that it's hard to imagine ever feeling normal again.\n\nDoctor: Do you believe that the voices you hear and the plots against your shop are real, or could they be a product of your own mind or stress from caregiving?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends keep telling me it doesn't make sense, and I know there is no one there when I check, but these experiences feel completely real to me. Even when I try to convince myself it is just the stress of caregiving, I can't shake the deep belief that the plots are real and those voices are actually there.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe in more detail how the plots against your shop and the voices relate to each other, and do you think the voices are directly involved in the plotting or just commenting on your situation?\n\nPatient: They feel connected because both the plotting and the voices focus entirely on my failures. The male and female voices whisper late at night that I'm a terrible wife and that everyone knows I'm failing, which feels like they are commenting on and mocking my situation. I don't think the voices themselves are plotting, but rather they are confirming that the people at the market really are judging me and trying to ruin my business.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any moments where you questioned the reality of the voices or the plots against your shop, or if there have been times when you felt like these beliefs might not be true?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do have moments of doubt, especially because my husband and friends keep telling me the plots make no sense, and when I check the room after hearing the voices, no one is there and the TV is off. But despite those logical contradictions, the whispers and the feeling of being judged still feel incredibly real and are so hard to shake in the moment.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how you distinguish between the times when you believe the plots and voices are real and the moments when you doubt their reality, and what triggers these shifts in your perception?\n\nPatient: It is really hard to say because when it is happening, the voices and the plots feel completely real to me. I don't really experience clear shifts or know what triggers those brief moments of doubt, other than just feeling completely overwhelmed by everything.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how your belief in the plots and the voices affects your behavior on a daily basis, and do you think your actions are influenced by these beliefs in a way that impacts your relationships or daily functioning?\n\nPatient: The fear of people plotting and the whispering voices make me just want to hide away from everyone. I keep my shop closed, ignore customer messages, and stay isolated in my garden because I feel so judged and overwhelmed. This has caused me to stop going to my usual social activities and has made it incredibly hard to keep up with my business and daily chores.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever felt like the voices or the perceived plots against your shop are directly controlling your actions or thoughts, or if you feel like you're acting on your own but being influenced by these beliefs?\n\nPatient: No, I don't feel like a puppet or that some outside force is physically controlling my body or thoughts. I am acting on my own, but the constant whispering and the intense fear of those plotting customers heavily influence my decisions. It makes me feel so paralyzed that I just want to hide, close my shop, and avoid people altogether.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any thoughts of harming yourself or others due to the stress of the perceived plots and the voices, or if you've felt like you're in immediate danger because of these beliefs?\n\nPatient: I have to admit I've had thoughts of wishing I just wouldn't wake up, and I've even counted the leftover pain pills in the bathroom so my husband wouldn't have to deal with me anymore, though I haven't acted on it. I have never had any thoughts of harming anyone else, though. And while the voices and the plots are incredibly stressful and make me feel judged, I don't feel like I am in any immediate physical danger from them.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you have ever had any other unusual beliefs or delusions, aside from the plots against your shop and the whispering voices, that you feel are absolutely true, even if others might not agree?\n\nPatient: No, there isn't anything else like that. The whispering voices at night and the feeling that people at the market are plotting against my shop are the only things of that nature I've experienced. It's just those two things, and they are already more than enough for me to carry.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how your belief in the plots and voices would change if someone you deeply trust, like your husband, were to tell you that he has investigated and found no evidence of anyone plotting against your shop?\n\nPatient: My husband and friends have actually tried to reassure me many times and told me there is no evidence, and even though I trust him completely, I still can't shake the belief. It just feels so incredibly real to me that his reassurance doesn't make the suspicion or the whispering voices go away.\n\nDoctor: Do you think that if the plotting against your shop and the whispering voices were to stop, your feelings of depression, guilt, and worthlessness would also improve, or do you believe these are separate issues?\n\nPatient: I feel like they are somewhat separate but overlapping issues. The whispering voices and the plotting actually started first, back when I was still going to yoga and the market and didn't feel deeply depressed yet. Now they occur at the same time and make everything feel much heavier, but because they started at different times, they still feel like distinct problems.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any periods where the whispering voices stopped or significantly decreased in frequency, and if so, did your beliefs about the plots against your shop change during those times?\n\nPatient: No, the whispering voices and the feelings about people plotting against my shop have never really stopped or decreased. Both of them have been constant for well over a year now. Even during those rare, brief moments when my mood felt a little lighter, the whispers and suspicions stayed just as persistent.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had any periods where you questioned the accuracy of your perceptions or the reality of the voices and plots, and if so, what triggered those moments of questioning?\n\nPatient: I do question them sometimes, especially when I check the quiet house to find the TV off, or when my husband insists the plots make no sense. But even when those checks make me doubt, I ultimately can't shake the beliefs. The whispers and the feeling of being targeted still feel completely real to me, no matter what.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe how the whispering voices influence your daily decisions and actions, and do you feel like you're acting based on the voices' messages or your own thoughts and feelings?\n\nPatient: The voices don't directly command me to do things, but because they whisper late at night that I'm a terrible wife and failing at everything, they deeply reinforce my own constant feelings of guilt and worthlessness. While I make decisions based on my own heavy sadness and exhaustion, the voices make those thoughts of being a failure feel much more real and inescapable.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you think the voices and plots against your shop would stop if you were to receive treatment for your depression and guilt, or do you believe they are independent of your mood and would continue regardless?\n\nPatient: I believe the voices and the plotting are independent of my mood because they actually started before the heavy depression and guilt fully took over, back when I was still going to yoga and managing to socialize. Even though I experience both the low mood and the whispers together now, they still feel like separate things. Because of that, I feel like they might continue even if my mood were to get better.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe if there are any specific events, emotions, or situations that trigger the whispering voices or make them louder, and do you feel like the voices are trying to communicate something specific to you?\n\nPatient: The whispering doesn't seem to have a specific trigger, but it happens several times a week, especially late at night when the house is quiet. It is always a male and a female voice, and they whisper very specific, hurtful things to me. They tell me that I'm a terrible wife and that everyone knows I'm failing both at the shop and with my husband.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you've ever had any other types of hallucinations, such as seeing or smelling things that aren't there, in addition to the whispering voices you've described?"

No, I have never seen or smelled things that aren't there, and I haven't experienced any other types of hallucinations. The only thing I hear is those whispering voices late at night when the house is quiet. Aside from that, there is nothing else like that.
